text:
Predicates:
Capital(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
CapitalCity(x) ::: x is the capital city of the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
HostedBothSeasons(x) ::: x has hosted the Summer and Winter Olympics and the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
UniversityCount(x, n) ::: x has n universities.
TopUniversities(x) ::: x has universities that consistently rank among the best in the world.
Premises:
Capital(beijing, peoplesRepublicOfChina) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
CapitalCity(beijing) ::: Beijing is the capital city of the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(beijing, northernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Hosted(beijing, summerOlympics2008) ∧ Hosted(beijing, summerParalympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics Games.
HostedBothSeasons(beijing) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer and Winter Olympics and the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
UniversityCount(beijing, 91) ∧ TopUniversities(beijing) ::: Many of Beijing's 91 universities consistently rank among the best universities in the world.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Larger(beijing, x) ∧ City(x, china) ∧ ∀y (City(y, china) → ¬Larger(y, beijing))) ::: Beijing is the second largest Chinese city.
